answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with per-identity bonding: every participant locks a non-refundable copper stake in a public registry, and a rotating prism verifier audits a random sample each epoch. Payout follows locked capital rather than the number of names, so cloning yourself into a thousand wallets earns nothing extra while tying up a thousand bonds. Detected duplicates are slashed. To seize a quarter of the vote an attacker must lock a third of all stake, frozen and forfeit on exposure, leaving the nectar of rewards to genuinely distinct agents.
